description: Create a 3PL client (publisher/owner). Name and code are required; code must be unique within the tenant (re-using an existing code is rejected, not duplicated). Management mode is pssc_managed (default) or publisher_managed. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token on a 3PL tenant. Returns the created client, whose id is what you pin subsequent inventory/price-book/quote work to.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

input.description: The client to create (name and code required).

annualHoldingCostRatePctOverride.description: Optional per-client annual carrying-cost rate percent (0-100); null inherits the tenant default.

code.description: Short code for the client (required) — unique within the tenant; used to reference it.

externalFeedExpectedCadenceHours.description: Optional expected external-feed cadence in hours (1-8760).

externalFeedSource.description: Optional external-feed source label for non-warehoused publishers (e.g. "Circle").

externalFeedStalenessThresholdHours.description: Optional external-feed staleness window in hours (1-2160); null inherits the tenant default.

idealOrderCadenceDaysOverride.description: Optional per-client order cadence in days (1-3650); null inherits the tenant default.

isActive.description: Whether the client is active (default true).

managementMode.description: Who manages fulfillment: pssc_managed (default) or publisher_managed.

optionMethodologyOverride.description: Optional per-client run-option methodology override (BalancedReturn, CashPreservation, or ProfitFirst); null inherits the tenant default.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is created until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
